note: Regional terrain sampled directly from the USGS 3DEP elevation service and a clipped Natural Earth Colorado River centerline. Relief is exaggerated 5 times; the cyan line is widened for visibility and draped on the mesh, not a water-depth survey. The map window includes context beyond the canyon and does not define its rim or exact Lees Ferry-to-Grand Wash endpoints. The independent 446 km ruler represents the published river-course length; the geographic map is not stretched to that route length. Horizontal coordinates are not normalized to the catalog size. Colors are illustrative. The opaque sides and flat underside are arbitrary display cuts, not real cliffs or geological strata.
